ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR49] Requires First Bill Date on moving into Negotiation, Booking Verification, Booked, Setup or Closed. Simplified per IRM. Note: 'First Bill Date' maps to IM_Booked_Date__c.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed') ) ),
ISBLANK(IM_Booked_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First Bill Date is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a date.
